name: Oneirofobia
source:
Oneirofobia (or Oneirophobia in English) is a story about a young university teacher who fears his dreams due to a traumatic event in his childhood. He's now able to see the future and the past through those dreams. Will the nightmare consume you?

With that in mind, you must choose what to believe and what not to from these visions... But remember, your mind can be deceiving...

[From [url=https://eddy-zatellsing.itch.io/oneirofobia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Oneirofobia（英语为Oneirophobia）讲述了一位年轻的大学老师由于童年的创伤事件而害怕自己的梦想的故事。他现在能够通过这些梦看到未来和过去。噩梦会吞噬你吗？

考虑到这一点，你必须从这些愿景中选择相信什么、不相信什么……但请记住，你的思想可能会欺骗……

[来自[url=https://eddy-zatellsing.itch.io/oneirofobia]Itch.io[/url]]
